# Error code catalog (generated)

> Generated by `npm run docs:generate:errors` from `domain/errors.js`. Do not edit by hand.

The catalog is the source of truth for the stable codes and the recovery metadata the tool boundary
renders: `retryable` marks a failure that can succeed later unchanged, and `nextAction` is the
single recovery step appended to the message as ` — next: …` (with ` (retryable)` when retryable).

| Code | Meaning | Retryable | Next action |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invalid-argument` | A tool argument is missing, malformed, or not allowed. | no | — |
| `repo-invalid` | repoRoot is missing, relative, or not inside a Git repository. | no | pass an absolute path to a directory inside a Git repository |
| `not-initialized` | Tower is not initialized for this repository; run tower_init. | no | run tower_init for this repository |
| `mission-not-found` | No mission with that id exists. | no | list missions with tower_status |
| `finding-not-found` | No finding with that id exists. | no | list findings with tower_findings |
| `invalid-transition` | The requested state transition is not allowed. | no | — |
| `stale-base` | The repository state changed while the operation was being prepared; retry. | yes | retry the tool; if it keeps failing, run tower_preflight and inspect tower_status |
| `state-locked` | Another Tower writer holds the state lock. | yes | wait for the other Tower writer to finish, then retry |
| `state-corrupt` | The Tower state file is unreadable or invalid. | no | restore state.json from a backup, or re-initialize after filing the corruption |
| `state-version-unsupported` | The Tower state file uses a schema version this build cannot read or downgrade. | no | upgrade dsh-tower to a release that supports this state schemaVersion |
| `state-migration-failed` | A Tower state migration failed; the original state file was not modified. | no | restore the pre-migration backup state.json.v<N>.bak and report the migration bug |
| `config-invalid` | Tower configuration is invalid. | no | fix the repository config file, then retry |
| `config-unknown-key` | Tower configuration has an unknown top-level key. | no | remove the unknown key from the repository config file, then retry |
| `git-failed` | A git command failed. | no | — |
| `git-timeout` | A git command timed out or exceeded its output buffer. | yes | retry; if it persists, raise git.timeoutMs or merge.timeoutMs |
| `worktree-dirty` | The mission worktree has uncommitted changes and cannot complete. | no | commit or remove the worktree changes, then retry tower_complete |
| `spawn-unavailable` | The subagents service is unavailable. | no | enable the DSH subagents service, then retry |
| `provider-missing` | No subagent provider is registered. | no | register a subagent provider in the DSH profile, then retry |
| `provider-cooldown` | The provider is throttled; spawn is in a short cooldown. | yes | wait for the cooldown to expire, then retry |
| `preset-missing` | The configured agent preset is not registered. | no | install the tower-worker and tower-reviewer agent presets and restart DSH |
| `reviewer-prerequisite` | The reviewer spawn prerequisite is not met. | no | complete the mission first, then spawn the reviewer |
| `review-disabled` | Review is disabled by `review.mode:off`; no reviewer, verdict, or review blocker exists in this configuration. | no | set review.mode to optional or required in the Tower config, then retry |
| `not-authorized` | The calling agent role may not perform this action. | no | call the tool as the tower, or as the worker/reviewer it is assigned to |
| `workspace-busy` | Another Tower session owns this repository workspace lock. | yes | run /tower off in the other session or wait for its lock to become stale |
| `worker-limit` | The repository reached spawn.maxLiveWorkers live workers. | no | wait for a live worker to finish or raise spawn.maxLiveWorkers |
| `rate-limited` | The tower_send per-minute rate limit was reached. | yes | wait for the next per-minute window or raise send.maxPerMinute |
| `takeover-refused` | The mission already has a live worker that was not stopped first. | no | run tower_interrupt for the live worker, then retry the takeover |
| `reload-unavailable` | The DSH HMR service is not available in this profile. | no | restart DSH instead of reloading |
| `reload-failed` | The HMR reload failed; check the DSH log and restart if needed. | no | check the DSH log and restart DSH |
| `tests-failed` | Declared test discovery failed or did not meet its admission requirements. | no | fix the failing tests, then retry tower_complete |
| `tests-timeout` | Test discovery exceeded its time or output budget. | no | raise tests.timeoutMs or tests.maxBytes (or speed up the suite), then retry |
| `lease-busy` | Another holder owns the requested advisory lease. | no | release the lease or wait for it to expire, then retry |
| `lease-token` | The lease release token does not match the current holder. | no | use the token returned when the lease was acquired |
| `batch-invalid` | The batch request or its close evidence is invalid. | no | fix the batch request or the receipt hashes, then retry |
| `legacy-invalid` | The legacy snapshot or mapping is invalid. | no | check the legacy snapshot path, schema and mapping, then retry |
| `tool-internal` | An unexpected failure; read the message and the activity log. | no | — |
